ety.text: Etymology tree Proto-Slavic *padežь Old Church Slavonic падєжь (padežĭ)bor. Russian падеж Borrowed from Old Church Slavonic падєжь (padežĭ), from Proto-Slavic *padežь. Doublet of падёж (padjóž), the inherited East Slavic form. The sense of “grammatical case” is a calque of Latin cāsus, which is also derived from the verb for falling, cadō (and is itself a calque from Ancient Greek πτῶσις (ptôsis)). Compare Bulgarian паде́ж (padéž), Serbo-Croatian padež.
